content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party that is not generally known to the public.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose such information to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until all Confidential Information has been made publicly available through no fault of the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 15th day of September 2024.
